products.name: PyTorch
products.note: Deep learning framework; model checkpoint governance; TorchServe deployment; research-to-production lineage

profile_text.body:
Meta / Linux Foundation is the joint stewardship arrangement behind PyTorch, an open source deep learning framework. The PyTorch Foundation describes itself as the deep learning community home for the PyTorch framework and ecosystem, operating as a community-oriented body rather than a conventional commercial entity.

The primary product tracked is PyTorch itself, covering deep learning model development, model checkpoint governance, deployment via TorchServe, and a research-to-production lineage. The site also references Captum, described as an open source, extensible library for model interpretability built on PyTorch, with its name derived from the Latin word for "comprehension." Additionally, the site notes ongoing work to keep the software compilation stack current with a fast-moving AI model landscape.

No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the held facts for this entity.
